sources.snippet: A realtime full-duplex voice runtime for AI coding agents (Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode, and other ACP agents). It uses sherpa-onnx keyword spotting with the 3M-parameter zh-en transducer model to implement a local voice wake word: the app sleeps on idle but keeps the microphone open, and the wake phrase brings the session back with no cloud calls.
